study type: retrospective cross-sectional study with a before/after comparison
outcome: coverage of delivery assisted by skilled personnel
cohort: The study was conducted in 14 health facilities in the sub-prefectures of Dekoa and Mala (Kemo health district, CAR) that had implemented performance-based financing.
finding: Performance-based financing significantly improved the number of skilled personnel, medical equipment, health infrastructure, coverage of delivery assisted by skilled personnel, ANC4+ antenatal consultation, and Penta 3 vaccine coverage.
cross-section timing: Data was collected in June 2024 for the period between 2019 and 2020.
